verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming tool. Data portability is a fair question for remote-access tools, which can hold paired-device lists, settings or logs, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no export feature or open-format data dump. Sill has no account or server and keeps logs in a local folder, but these are adjacent facts, not a documented capability to export your data and leave.
